$comment: What core/tests/AudioSnapshot renders. Resource paths are relative to core/tests/testdata/assets. Node types are aliases (core/protocol/effect-aliases.json), so one definition serves every revision; a node gets the params a freshly added node gets unless it sets freshParams: false, then its own params on top. Without edges, nodes run in series between __input__ and __output__. See tools/audio-ab/README.md.

resources.nam-drive: amps/Guitar/TimR/JCM800 2203 1985/JCM800 Hi P6 B8 M4 T7 G6.nam

chains.name: New Preset with an amp model
chains.description: The New Preset template (BuildNewPreset in core/src/controller/PluginControllerPresetEdits.cpp, which newPreset loads), with a model loaded into the Neural Amp. The gate, Neural FX and IR Cab are bypassed.

chains.name: New Preset with an amp and a cab
chains.description: The same template with the IR Cab switched on: the first thing most players do with a new preset.

chains.name: Calibrated clean amp and cab
chains.description: A clean model that carries input/output level metadata, so the controller's NAM calibration and auto-gain are both in play, into an IR cab. Fresh-node params throughout.

chains.name: Full pedalboard
chains.description: A typical rig in series, every node as freshly added: gate, compressor, overdrive, amp, cab, EQ, chorus, delay, reverb.

chains.name: Full pedalboard, Global FX on
chains.description: The same pedalboard with every Global FX node switched on at its defaults: gate and transpose before the preset, EQ and doubler after it.

chains.name: Wet/dry parallel rig
chains.description: Amp and cab into a splitter: a dry path, and a delay and reverb wet path, summed by a mixer node. Exercises parallel branches, their latency alignment and the mixer.

chains.name: Built-in amp rig
chains.description: The built-in amp into the simple cab and a spring reverb. Needs no model or IR files, so it isolates the engine's own amp modelling.
